_comment: Write-lane contract for multi-agent work. A commit tagged `Lane: X` may only change files matching lanes.X.write. Paths in `protected` are director-only. Enforced by tools/director/lane_check.py (CI job lane-check).
protected_note: client/data/** is protected because it mirrors canon (checked by tools/content/check_client_sync.py); the client lane changes it only through a director-issued task that lists it under `extra_write`.
